facts.fact: TechnoMag says Starlink's Johannesburg gateway sits at the Teraco campus and peers at the NAPAfrica exchange, so NAPAfrica in Johannesburg is in service with networks peering; the article gives no member count and no event date, so the 2026-06-29 publication date is used.

TechnoMag says Starlink's Johannesburg gateway at the Teraco campus peers at the JINX exchange, so JINX in Johannesburg is in service with networks peering; no member count and no event date are given, so the 2026-06-29 publication date is used.

note: Regional Starlink article; only the Johannesburg gateway peering lines concern ZAF exchanges. Starlink is a satellite ISP, so not recorded as a content network; no traffic, growth or reach statement.
